blocked.resolution: A later authorized job may inspect one selected public offering website and record a verified recording locator.
Do not invent a required textbook; later managers may classify optional readings separately with provenance.
Select one offering, verify permitted public access, and ingest each assignment as a distinct versioned record.
Use only through an explicitly authorized learner account and current course policy; never automate enrollment or treat access as completion evidence.
A later retrieval job may select one offering and verify allowed public content under the policy below.
A later retrieval job may inspect provenance, license, safety, and offering alignment before using repository content.

retrieval_policy.current_job: Use only the supplied catalog snapshot and manager-authored local material; perform no external retrieval.
retrieval_policy.public_content: A later authorized job may retrieve public HTTPS resources after selecting exactly one course offering and recording URL, access date, license or use basis, content hash, and offering identity.
retrieval_policy.restricted_content: Do not bypass authentication, paywalls, enrollment controls, robots restrictions, access controls, or repository permissions. Do not obtain private submissions, solutions, hidden tests, sealed references, or another learner's files.
retrieval_policy.third_party_services: Do not create accounts, enroll with invitation codes, submit work, or invoke external autograders without explicit user authorization.
retrieval_policy.versioning: Keep material from different offerings separate. A later expansion must identify dependencies and must not silently replace or merge versions.
retrieval_policy.promotion: A link or normalized record is not an official unit. Promote it only after availability, provenance, permissions, stable identity, and content are deterministically recorded.
retrieval_policy.failure_handling: Record failed retrieval attempts and reasons; never label absent, blocked, or unverified content as available.
